blocks.text: Instead of drowning you in dashboards, SyNexus runs four Sentinel lanes in parallel and fuses them into one risk band and score with human-readable reasons.
Aegis covers security and privacy — scams, rugs, contracts, liquidity. Pulse tracks volume and momentum integrity. Leviathan watches whales. Cipher matches naming traps and swarm reports.
Scores use heuristics and third-party APIs. They can be wrong or delayed. Always verify mint addresses and do your own research before trading.
